fields.passwordRule: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.

signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to keep your streak going.
signIn.guestHint: Try a lesson first. You can create an account later and keep your progress.

signUp.title: Create your account
signUp.subtitle: Save your progress and appear on the leaderboard.

linkAccount.title: Save your progress
linkAccount.subtitle: You're learning as a guest. Add an email to keep your XP, streak and achievements on any device.
linkAccount.keepsProgress: Your progress stays exactly as it is.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.subtitle: We'll email you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {{email}}, a reset link is on its way. The link works once and expires in an hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: Pick something you haven't used here before.
resetPassword.successBody: You're signed in and ready to go.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.body: Enter your current password, then the new one. Any other device signed in to your account will be signed out.
changePassword.done: Password changed. Your other devices have been signed out.

verifyEmail.title: Confirm your email
verifyEmail.subtitle: We sent a link to {{email}}. Open it on this device to finish setting up your account.
verifyEmail.spamHint: No email? Check your spam folder.

session.guestSignOutWarning: You're a guest. Signing out deletes your progress on this device for good.

email.invalid: That doesn't look like an email address.

password.needs-letter-and-digit: Include at least one letter and one number.

errors.invalid-credentials: That email and password don't match an account.
errors.email-not-confirmed: Confirm your email address first — check your inbox for the link.
errors.email-taken: That email is already registered. Try signing in instead.
errors.weak-password: That password is too weak. Use at least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
errors.same-password: That's your current password. Choose a different one.
errors.rate-limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.expired-link: That link has expired or was already used. Request a new one.
errors.guest-disabled: Guest mode is unavailable right now. Create an account to continue.
errors.network: No internet connection. Check your signal and try again.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
